name: Wispr Flow
tagline: Voice dictation that works in any app and tidies what you say into clear writing.
about: Wispr Flow turns speech into polished text wherever you can type. It removes filler words and fixes punctuation as you speak.
pros: Works in any text box on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android.
Removes filler words and fixes punctuation.
cons: Audio is processed in the cloud.
The free plan limits how much you can dictate.
